menus.label: Branch opening menu

items.name: 黄金のきな粉もちもちパン — golden kinako chewy bread
黒豚甘口カレーパン — mild black-pork curry bread
はちみつフレンチトースト — honey French toast
新食感生ドーナツ — soft-texture doughnut

menus.note: Branch-specific operator opening flyer mirrored by Pan Navi, visually transcribed; tax-inclusive prices. Kinako bread contains homemade sweet-potato filling. Photographs are promotional examples, not a guarantee of daily availability. Four published items are a sample of the advertised approximately 100 breads. This branch’s curry bread and French-toast prices differ from the other new Fukuoka branch. Official Hatoya home/shop gallery returned timeout/502; checked linked operator Instagram and recruitment pages, local on-site opening-sign photographs and both branch flyers. No other-branch menu or food photograph borrowed. Exact closed days, complete menu and direct branch telephone remain unpublished; flyer phone 099-293-1226 is employer recruitment contact, not a verified shop number.

items.name: Hot coffee
items.note: Complimentary service for bread shoppers; bread purchase is paid separately

menus.note: The branch opening flyer advertises free hot coffee. Pan Navi explicitly describes bread-purchase eligibility for Nagaoka and coffee with shopping for Akasaka. No published end date, quantity limit or refill policy; confirm any unlisted conditions with the shop.
